ratified_by: USER (explicit instruction: '유동성 기준 선택' in reply to CIO proposal '유동성 기준 채택')
scope: T2 PAPER candidate condition C3 (liquidity) for KR and US. INTERNAL_VIRTUAL_PAPER_ONLY. REAL gets separate stricter limits later.
basis: Per-name max 5% of KRW 200,000,000 = about KRW 10,000,000; position must not exceed 1% of 20-session average traded value.

KR.window: 20 completed KRX sessions; fewer than 20 sessions of history -> NOT_EVALUATED (no T2)

US.window: 20 completed US sessions; fewer than 20 -> NOT_EVALUATED (no T2)

CRYPTO.unchanged: previously ratified Upbit 24h traded value >= KRW 5,000,000,000

fail_closed: Missing price history, missing halt/admin/exchange flag, or stale data -> C3 UNKNOWN -> no T2.
position_cap_link: PAPER order size for a name is additionally capped at 1% of its 20-session average traded value.
expected_pass_counts: estimate only (KR ~1,000, US ~2,000); to be measured once TKT-2 price history lands
